subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining #44431 browser field-report items should become first-class browser API behavior now, rather than staying as skill guidance or separate future research?
rationale: Current main already shipped the low-risk selector and batch ergonomics, but the remaining stale-state, CAPTCHA, readiness, inspection, and post-action context behaviors affect model-facing contracts and need an owner-approved API shape.

options.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
options.body: Create focused follow-ups for refsStale/captchaDetected/readiness/post-action refresh semantics and require live browser proof for each before merging.

options.title: Limit to guidance for now
options.body: Keep the remaining behavior in the browser automation skill/docs and close only narrower reproducible bugs as they appear.

options.title: Sponsor broader browser API expansion
options.body: Design a larger browser action/result API covering inspection, diffs, recovery signals, and form verification in one coordinated project.

recommendation.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
recommendation.body: Create focused follow-ups for refsStale/captchaDetected/readiness/post-action refresh semantics and require live browser proof for each before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior browser action contract work that partially implemented this issue and recently maintained the same route/type surfaces.
